title: Butter Chicken
description: Butter chicken with no butter in it: evaporated light milk and cooking spray stand in, which keeps the saturated fat under 2 g a serve. It is thinner and sharper than a restaurant version, so lean on the paprika and cinnamon.
equipment: large non-stick frying pan or wok

items.raw: 4 tablespoons no added salt tomato paste
1 x 375 ml can evaporated light milk

steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces.
Coat a large non-stick frying pan or wok with cooking spray and saute the chicken, onion, garlic and ginger until the chicken is nearly cooked.
Add all the spices and the stock powder and combine with the chicken for one minute.
Add the tomato paste and fold it through the chicken.
Blend the cornflour with the evaporated milk, add it to the pan and stir continuously, mixing well, until it comes to the boil and thickens.

notes: The source offers lean rump steak, butterfly pork steak or 600 g tofu in place of the chicken.
Cornflour and evaporated milk both dislike a hard boil. Keep stirring and take it off the heat as soon as it thickens.
There is no chilli heat to speak of at an eighth of a teaspoon. Take it up if you want it to bite.
